decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It  is considered that this application for a rear extension to this dwellinghouse , because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 8 Osterley Crescent and is complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development) ENV B 2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the west wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to existing dwellinghouse.
